name: wind-clouds-visual
description: Visual verification of ambient wind/clouds (#458 T7.1/D12): clouds drift, terrain cloud-shadow patches sweep in sync with them, and a sunny->storm weather transition visibly thickens/darkens the cloud layer.

steps.description: A real (non-tutorial) level so the landscape zone + cloud disc are big enough to read clearly.

expect.note: dusty_hollow's terrain (96) replaces the sandbox default (64) — DEFAULT_GRID_SIZE, world.ts

steps.description: Frame capture needs the render loop actually ticking dt forward for wind/cloud drift to animate.
Baseline: sparse coverage (0.25), clouds should still visibly drift frame to frame. — weather has no player-facing control; test-only forcing hook. Left unmarked.

Coverage lerps toward 1.0 and cloud material darkens — captured frames should show the layer thickening/darkening over the sequence, not snapping instantly. — weather has no player-facing control; test-only forcing hook. Left unmarked.
